name: listarr
description: Listarr is a self-hosted web application that automates discovery and bulk import of movies and TV shows from TMDB into Radarr and Sonarr. Configure scheduled lists based on genres, keywords, or popular/trending content and let Listarr handle the imports automatically.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Stores the database, encryption key, and generated config. Must be a persistent path.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Listarr web interface.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Server timezone used for cron schedule interpretation. Example: Europe/London, America/New_York.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Python logging verbosity. INFO is recommended for normal use.

variables.name: Secret Key Override
variables.description: Optional: override the auto-generated Flask secret key. Leave blank to use the auto-generated key stored in the instance directory.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true when Listarr is served behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. Enables the Secure flag on session cookies.

variables.name: Flask Debug
variables.description: Enable Flask debug mode. Never enable in production.
